text:
Predicates:
YaleUniversity(x) ::: x is Yale University.
Private(x) ::: x is a private institution.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League institution.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
EndowmentValue(x, y) ::: x's endowment is valued at y.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(c) ::: c is a residential college.
YaleGraduateSchool(y) ::: y is Yale's Graduate School of Arts and Sciences.
ProfessionalSchool(s) ::: s is a professional school.
At(y, c) ::: y is at c.
Name(c, n) ::: c has name n.
YaleEndowment(y, v) ::: Yale's endowment was valued at v.
LargestEndowment(x) ::: x has the largest endowment.

Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ∧ Private(yale) ∧ IvyLeague(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ∧ Year(yale, 1716) ::: Yale moved to New Haven in 1716.
EndowmentValue(yale, 42.3 billion) ::: Yale's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yale, [residentialColleges, YaleGraduateSchool, professionalSchools]) ::: Yale is organized into various colleges and schools.
Name(benjaminFranklin, "Benjamin Franklin College") ∧ At(benjaminFranklin, yale) ::: Benjamin Franklin College is at Yale.
Name(berkeley, "Berkeley College") ∧ At(berkeley, yale) ::: Berkeley College is at Yale.
(…similar for other colleges…) ::: (Similarly listed colleges)
YaleEndowment(yale, v) ::: Yale's endowment is valued at v.

Conclusion:
LargestEndowment(yale) ::: Yale University has the largest university endowment of any educational institution.
